title: Rethinking neurodegeneration: Placing disease in its physiological context
content:
by Joanna Clarke, Sarah Jäkel

Research into neurodegeneration is often confined to a single disease, cell type or mechanism. A new collection of articles explores neurodegeneration within its physiological context, looking beyond diseased neurons to the surrounding tissue microenvironment.
